issues.display_title: Issue #4183: Handle Stripe 3DS confirmation for space addon (buy storage)
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Add Stripe 3D Secure (3DS) confirmation handling to the space addon ("buy storage") purchase flow, mirroring the existing upgrade-plan 3DS pattern. The backend now supports this (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1773); the dashboard currently has no code path for it.

Current state

useSpaceAddon.jsx:114-143 (handleSpaceAddon) calls POST /v2/payment/subscription/space-addon and only ever treats the response as success (onCompleted → handleSpaceAddonSuccess) or failure (onError → handleSpaceAddonError). There is no check for a 202/requires_action response.

useDowngradeOrUpgrade.jsx:288-361 (handleDowngradeOrUpgrade) already implements this for the upgrade flow:

  • checks plan?.action === 'UPGRADE' && res.data.status === 'requires_action'
  • builds a Stripe client via window.Stripe(...) (test/live key picked by isTestUserForPayment(userId))
  • calls stripeClient.confirmCardPayment(res.data.client_secret)
  • on result.paymentIntent.status === 'succeeded', posts { pi: res.data.client_secret } to a completion endpoint (complete3DsUpgrade, POST /v2/payment/subscription/complete-3ds-upgrade)
  • on completion success/error, calls the same handleDowngradeOrUpgradeSuccess/handleDowngradeOrUpgradeError the non-3DS path already uses

Because space-addon never checks for requires_action, a user whose card requires 3DS today just sees the generic buy-storage failure modal (handleSpaceAddonError) even though the card itself is fine.

Target state

handleSpaceAddon in useSpaceAddon.jsx follows the same branch handleDowngradeOrUpgrade uses:

  • if res.data.status === 'requires_action': run stripeClient.confirmCardPayment(res.data.client_secret), then on success POST { pi: res.data.client_secret } to POST /v2/payment/subscription/complete-space-addon-3ds (new hook, e.g. completeSpaceAddon3ds), then call the existing handleSpaceAddonSuccess/handleSpaceAddonError on that call's outcome
  • if result.error from confirmCardPayment: call handleSpaceAddonError
  • otherwise (no requires_action): unchanged, existing success/error handling

No new UI/modal needed — usePaymentStatus's existing showPaymentStatus({ type: 'success' | 'failed' }) (already used by both handleSpaceAddonSuccess and handleSpaceAddonError) covers both outcomes of the 3DS-completed flow too.

Scope

  • src/components/organism/PaymentV2/Hooks/useSpaceAddon.jsx
    • add [completeSpaceAddon3ds] = usePost({ url: '/v2/payment/subscription/complete-space-addon-3ds' })
    • handleSpaceAddon — branch on res.data.status === 'requires_action' inside the spaceAddon(...) onCompleted, matching useDowngradeOrUpgrade.jsx:305-346

Out of scope

  • useDowngradeOrUpgrade.jsx — already handles 3DS for upgrade, not touched.
  • SpaceAddOn.jsx (UI component) and PaymentV2.jsx — no prop/UI changes expected; handleSpaceAddon's external contract (the returned Promise) stays the same.
  • Any new modal component — reuse usePaymentStatus.

Risk / test plan

  • Manual QA in Stripe test mode: buy storage with a 3DS test card → confirm the 3DS challenge appears (Stripe.js handles this via confirmCardPayment), complete it, confirm the buy-storage success modal appears and storage is granted.
  • Manual QA: buy storage with a non-3DS test card → unchanged, completes without any 3DS prompt.
  • Manual QA: abandon/fail the 3DS challenge → confirm the buy-storage failure modal appears (via handleSpaceAddonError), not a silent hang.
